استرخصوا (form X)
# اِسْتَرْخَصُوا (istarḵaṣū) /is.tar.xa.sˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَرْخَصَ (istarḵaṣa)
# اُسْتُرْخِصُوا (usturḵiṣū) /us.tur.xi.sˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَرْخَصَ (istarḵaṣa)
# اِسْتَرْخِصُوا (istarḵiṣū) /is.tar.xi.sˤuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَرْخَصَ (istarḵaṣa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
